CustomField.description: After 6 months of getting onboarded of a supplier, if Science Based Target Status field of Supplier Scorecard is blank, then this checkbox will be checked
CustomField.formula: AND( IF( ( TODAY() - NZC_Supplier_Onboarded_Date1__c ) >= VALUE( $Label.NZC_SBTI_Updation_Limit_Time_in_Days ), True, False) , OR(ISBLANK(TEXT( ScienceBasedTargetStatus )), ISPICKVAL( ScienceBasedTargetStatus , 'Planning'), ISPICKVAL( ScienceBasedTargetStatus , 'Declined') ) )
CustomField.label: SBTI Updation Threshold
